title: 専門ゼミ
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)propose a problem for Design Project III.
(2)study a procedure to solve the problem.
(3)master the design, production, production technology.
(4)develop the basic abilities needed for design and production in order to suggest feasible ideas.
(5)learn the importance of cooperation with society.
advice:
Students will:
(1)	clarify the knowledge and skills necessary to accomplish a project carried out in Design Project III and confirm their ability to perform these.
(2)	clarify the knowledge and skills you need to augment your existing knowledge and skills, and apply them to learning new skills.
(3)	clarify the aim and the action plan of the Design Project III project as the class proceeds.
(4)	clarify the Design Project III proposal and evaluate these learning results, and confirm the degree of acquisition.
(5)	receive the following instructions from their lab teacher:
-rules and the administration methods in the laboratory
-usage of the apparatuses
-other conventions of lab use.

Note: The description above are the current plan; the details will be distributed at the time of the first class of the specialized seminar.
requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge and skills to take this course are presented in the first lecture of each laboratory.
Students cannot take Design Project III if the unit of specialized seminar (this subject) is not obtained.

activityGoals.body: Students have a clear image of the aim and the action plan of their Design Project III.
Students can explain the theme of their Design Project III.
Students acquire the knowledge and skills to independently accomplish their Design Project III.
Students come to understand laboratory conventions through experience.
Students understand the safety management guidelines to perform experiments and studies safely.
Students survey future courses and decide the direction of their study.
